title: Jhoola hai jala
body:
haathon mein liye nanhe se jhoole ko ye madar
bikhraye apne balon ko kehti rahi asghar
tu kya gaya ke chaya hai aankhon mein andhera
karbobala mein hogaya barbad mera ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoola hai jala ay laal tera
hai khaak basar ran mein bano
rone bhi nahi dete aada
hai khaak basar ran mein bano
<<DIVIDER>>
asbab luta qaime bhi jale
chadar bhi chini durre bhi lage
dooba hua gham mein hai kunba
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
ek hookh si dil mein uth'ti hai
aur dard jigar mein hota hai
hasta hua gulshan loota gaya
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
kano se lahoo jo behta hai
shikwa bhi kare to kisse kare
baba hai aur na uska chacha
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
wo sookhi labon ki yaadein bhi
yaad aati hai uski pyari haseen
yaad aati hai uski har ek ada
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
ye kaisi qayamat aayi hai
murjhayi gayi nanhi si kali
dhadkan mein hai matam ki sada
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
wan ghash mein pade hai zainul-liba
yan zainabe kubra ki hai fughan
kya maajra hai ya rab tu bata
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kaun sahara de usko
ab kaun dilaasa de usko
barbad hui uski dunya
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
<<DIVIDER>>
us din se lekar maut talak
saaye mein na baithi ahmed wo
dil ke hai hassan ke gham ye bada
hai khaak basar…
jhoola hai jala…
author: Zulfiqar Ahmed
